blurb:
Our 2026 Season features guest headliners from around the world including Brenda Kaye, Sailesh and Richard Barker!

Brace yourself for the wildest night of your vacation.
Winner of the Badge of Excellence and hailed as the #1 adult comedy show in Myrtle Beach, Steve Falcon’s Comedy Hypnosis Hour is a jaw-dropping mix of stand-up, chaos, and hypnotic insanity — direct from the Las Vegas Strip.

This is bold, unscripted, and outrageously funny — where you or your friends could end up the stars of the show!
Every night is different, every moment unexpected, and every volunteer leaves with a story they can’t believe actually happened.

⭐ “I laughed so hard I cried.”
⭐ “Best show of our entire trip.”
⭐ “We came back a second night — and it was totally different!”

Don’t wait — seats sell out fast.
With limited capacity and high demand, this experience is the talk of the town (and half the resort lobbies).

18+ only (with limited exceptions)
